english.title: Administrative receiver fail to give notice of his / her appointment
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been appointed as the administrative receiver of a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..), failed

(A)_[to forthwith send to the company and publish in the prescribed manner a notice of your appointment]_
(B)_[within 28 days after your appointment, to send a notice of your appointment to all the creditors of the company so far as you were aware of their addresses]_
(C)_[to forthwith send to the company and publish in the prescribed manner a notice of your appointment and within 28 days after your appointment, to send a notice of that appointment to all the creditors of the company so far as you were aware of their addresses]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 46 of, and Schedule 10 to, the Insolvency Act 1986.

english.notes:
(i) Section 46 of the Insolvency Act 1986 does not apply in relation to the appointment of an administrative receiver to act (a) with an existing administrative receiver, or (b) in place of an administrative receiver dying or ceasing to act, except that, where they apply to an administrative receiver who dies or ceases to act before they have been fully complied with, the references in this section and the next to the administrative receiver include (subject to the next subsection) his successor and any continuing administrative receiver.
(ii) Section 431 of the Insolvency Act 1986 provides that notwithstanding anything in section 127(1) of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980, an information relating to such an offence which is triable by a magistrates' court in England and Wales may be so tried if it is laid at any time within 3 years after the commission of the offence and within 12 months after the date on which evidence sufficient in the opinion of the Director of Public Prosecutions or the Secretary of State (as the case may be) to justify the proceedings comes to his knowledge. Summary proceedings in Scotland for such an offence shall not be commenced after the expiration of 3 years from the commission of the offence.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding one-fifth of statutory maximum or on a second or subsequent conviction to a fine not exceeding one-fiftieth of the statutory maximum for each day on which the contravention is continued.
